newsitem.title: HONG KONG: Dah Sing shares down after placement.
newsitem.headline: Dah Sing shares down after placement.

text.p: Shares of Dah Sing Financial Holdings Ltd fell on dilution fear after the company announced a HK$381 million share placement, brokers said on Tuesday.
"Even though the funds raised will be used to expand its business, underlying fear of dilution triggered selling," said a sales manager at a regional brokerage.
Dah Sing shares fell HK$1.20 or 3.30 percent to HK$35.20 by mid-morning.
Dah Sing had said it planned to issue 12.04 million new shares to an Abbey National Plc unit, raising HK$381 million to expand its banking and life insurance businesses.
The shares, representing about five percent of its enlarged shares, would be priced at HK$31.68 per share, it said.
